title: Advanced Drone Sensing Framework for Smart X Situational Intelligence: Streamlit Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility package for the revised manuscript Advanced Drone Sensing Framework for Smart X Situational Intelligence. The release contains the Streamlit prototype, exact controlled synthetic pollutant-weather, telemetry, and image-feature inputs, two-branch Isolation Forest and rule-based scoring code, fixed experiment configuration, paper-ready outputs for baseline detection, alpha sensitivity, modality ablation, and controlled-noise robustness, and persistent human-validation support. The package is limited to controlled synthetic evaluation and does not contain field measurements or claim field-validated deployment performance. Digital Twin, Data Lakehouse, and distributed edge-cloud services are architectural-readiness components rather than deployed production services.
